name: Lunalie El Blanca
original_name: ルナリエ=エル=ブランカ
source:
A new knight assigned to princess Jill's bodyguard. She was bulled as "the devil child" when young when Rabat adopted her from the orphanage and taught her martial skills. She is popular and trusted by the other guardsmen because she lacks career ambition.

Returning from the knighthood ceremony, the party is attacked by bandits and she is blighted internally by a lust parasite. To prove her innocence as the sole surviving member of the bodyguards, she makes the journey alone to the slave market city to rescue Jill.

Her cooking skills are abysmally poor, anyone brave enough to sample her food must prepare themselves for the consequences.

[Spoiler]
Can only seen in game by certain way.

Height: 160, Weight: 50
Bust: 85 (D), Waist: 56, Hips: 88
Hobby: Cooking. Special Ability: Repeated Sidesteps
Weakness: Boobs
[/Spoiler]
